spans.s: यथा ind. (used by itself) 1. As, as for example, e.g. यत्र यत्र धूमस्तत्र तत्र वह्निर्यथा महानसे; 2. like, as (often used in a simile to express the relation of similarity), नवपल्लवसंस्तरे यथा रचयिष्यामि तनुं विभावसौ K.S.iv.34; 3. it is used to introduce a direct assertion or a subordinate clause in the direct construction, आज्ञापितोऽस्मि परिषदा यथाद्य त्वया … नाटकं नाटयितव्यमिति Mud.i., K.S.iv.36 (in such cases, इति is often used at the end of the clause); (used with its correlative तथा which sometimes is omitted); 4. in which manner, just as, as, यदि यथा वदति क्षितिपस्तथा त्वमसि किं पुनरुत्कुलया त्वया Sak.iv., यथाज्ञापयति देवः i.; 5. so that, in order that, तस्मान्मुच्ये यथा तात संविधातुं तथार्हसि R.i.72; 6. since, because, मंदं मंदं नुदति पवनश्चानुकूलो यथा त्वाम् Megh.i.9; 7. as surely as, as much as, e.g. न तथा बाधते शीतं यथा बाधति बाधते. (See under तथा for other senses.)(It is generally followed by its correlative तथा, but sometimes by such words as एवम्, एवम् तद्वत्.)(In composition with nouns, यथा forms Avyay. compounds and has then the sense of ‘not going beyond,’ ‘according to.’)
यथा-अंशतस् ind. proportionately.
यथा-अधिकारम् ind. according to authority.
यथा-अधीत a. as read, according to the text.
यथा-अनुपूर्वम्, -अनुपूर्व्यम्, -अनुपूर्व्या ind. in regular order, successively.
यथा-अनुपूर्वम्, -अनुपूर्व्यम्, -अनुपूर्व्या ind. in regular order, successively.
यथा-अनुपूर्वम्, -अनुपूर्व्यम्, -अनुपूर्व्या ind. in regular order, successively.
यथा-अनुभूतम् ind. by previous experience.
यथा-अनुरूपम् ind. in exact conformity, properly.
यथा-अभिप्रेत, -अभिमत, -अभिलषित, -अभीष्ट a. as wished or intended, as desired.
यथा-अभिप्रेत, -अभिमत, -अभिलषित, -अभीष्ट a. as wished or intended, as desired.
यथा-अभिप्रेत, -अभिमत, -अभिलषित, -अभीष्ट a. as wished or intended, as desired.
यथा-अभिप्रेत, -अभिमत, -अभिलषित, -अभीष्ट a. as wished or intended, as desired.
यथा-अर्थ a. 1. true, actual, real, सौम्येति चाभाष्य यथार्थभाषी स्थितं निदेशे पृथगादिदेश R.xiv.44, K.S.ii.16; 2. right, appropriate, करिष्यत्रिव नामास्य यथार्थमरिनिग्रहात् R.xv.6, Kir.viii.49.
यथा-अर्थ˚नामन् a. whose name is appropriate, i.e. whose acts conform with his name, परंतपो नाम यथार्थनामा R.vi.21.
यथा-अर्थ˚वर्ण m. a spy (probably a corruption of यथार्हवर्ण q.v.).
यथा-अर्ह a. 1. as deserving; 2. appropriate, just.
यथा-अर्ह˚वर्ण m. a spy, a secret agent.
यथा-अर्हणम् ind. 1. according to merit; 2. according to propriety.
यथा-अवकाशम् ind. 1. according to space; 2. in the proper place, प्रालंबमुत्कृष्य यथावकाशं निनाय साचीकृतचारुवक्त्रः R.vi.14; 3. according to propriety or leisure.
यथा-अवस्थम् ind. according to condition or circumstances.
यथा-आख्यात a. before-mentioned.
यथा-आख्यानम् ind. as stated before.
यथा-आगतम् ind. by the same way as one came, यथागतं मातलिसारथिर्ययौ R.iii.67.
यथा-आचारम् ind. as usual or customary.
यथा-आम्नातम्, -आम्नायम् ind. according to the Vedas.
यथा-आम्नातम्, -आम्नायम् ind. according to the Vedas.
यथा-आरंभम् ind. according to the commencement, in regular succession.
यथा-आवासम् ind. each to his own abode, according to dwelling.
यथा-आशयम् ind. according to intention or stipulation.
यथा-आश्रमम् ind. according to the Āśrama or period of life.
यथा-इच्छ, -ईप्सित a. agreeably to desire, as much as wanted.
यथा-इच्छ, -ईप्सित a. agreeably to desire, as much as wanted.
यथा-इच्छम्, -ईप्सितम् ind. according to wish, at pleasure.
यथा-इच्छम्, -ईप्सितम् ind. according to wish, at pleasure.
यथा-इष्ट a. as desired, as wished for, as loved.
यथा-इष्टम् ind. according to wish, to the heart’s content, उन्मत्तवन्मधुकरः कमलं यथेष्टम् Ch.
यथा-ईक्षितम् ind. as beheld actually.
यथा-उक्त a. as said or told previouly, above-mentioned, प्रातर्यथोक्तव्र्तपारणांते R.ii.70.
यथा-उचित a. proper, suitable, becoming.
यथा-उचितम् ind. suitably, properly.
यथा-उत्तरम् ind. in regular succession, one after another, श्रैष्ठ्यमेषां यथोत्तरम् M.xii.38.
यथा-उत्साहम् ind. according to power, with all one’s might.
यथा-उदितम् ind. as mentioned before.
यथा-उद्दिष्टम्, -उद्देशम् ind. in the manner pointed out.
यथा-उद्दिष्टम्, -उद्देशम् ind. in the manner pointed out.
यथा-उपजोषम् ind. according to desire or pleasure.
यथा-उपदेशम् ind. according to advice or orders.
यथा-उपयोगम् ind. according to use or requiements.
यथा-ऋतु ind. according to the season, at the right season.
यथा-कर्म ind. according to action, duties, or circumstances.
यथा-कामम् ind. as one likes, at pleasure, to the heart’s content, स निर्विश्य यथाकामं तटेष्वालीनचंदनौ R.iv.51, i.6.
यथा-कालम् ind. at the right moment, सोऽपसर्पैर्जजगार यथाकालं स्वपन्नपि R.xvii.51.
यथा-कृत a. as agreed, done according to custom.
यथा-क्रमम्, -क्रमेण ind. in due succession, regularly, properly, यथाक्रमं पुंसवनादिकाः क्रियाः R.iii.10.
यथा-क्रमम्, -क्रमेण ind. in due succession, regularly, properly, यथाक्रमं पुंसवनादिकाः क्रियाः R.iii.10.
यथा-क्षमम् ind. according to ability, as much as possible.
यथा-जात a. senseless, foolish, barbarous.
यथा-ज्ञानम् ind. to the best of one’s knowledge or judgment.
यथा-ज्येष्ठम् ind. by seniority, according to rank.
यथा-तथ (I) a. 1. right, true; 2. accurate.
यथा-तथ (II) n. a detailed or minute account of events.
यथा-तथम् ind. 1. precisely, exactly; 2. fitly, in a suitable manner.
यथा-दिक्, -दिशम् ind. in all directions.
यथा-दिक्, -दिशम् ind. in all directions.
यथा-निर्दिष्ट a. as mentioned before, ततः प्रविशति यथानिर्दिष्टपरिवारो राजा Sak.ii.
यथा-न्यायम् ind. according to justice, rightly, properly.
यथा-पुरम् ind. as before, as on former occasions.
यथा-पूर्वम् ind. 1. as before, सर्वाणि ज्ञातिकर्माणि यथापूर्वं समाचरेत् M.xi.187; 2. in succession, one after another.
यथा-प्रदेशम् ind. 1. according to precept; 2. in a suitable or proper place, आसम्जयामास यथाप्रदेशं कंठे गुणं मूर्तमिवानुरागम् R.vi.83, K.S.i.49.
यथा-प्रधानम्, -प्रधानतस् ind. according to precedence, according to rank or position, आलोकमात्रेण सुरानशेषान् संभावयामास यथाप्रधानम् K.S.vii.46.
यथा-प्रधानम्, -प्रधानतस् ind. according to precedence, according to rank or position, आलोकमात्रेण सुरानशेषान् संभावयामास यथाप्रधानम् K.S.vii.46.
यथा-प्राणम् ind. with all one’s might.
यथा-प्रार्थितम् ind. as requested, by request.
यथा-बलम् ind. with all one’s might, to the best of one’s ability.
यथा-भागम् ind. 1. according to share, proportionately; 2. each in his respective place, in the proper place, यथाभागमवस्थिताः Bg.i.11, कश्चिद्यथाभागमवस्थितेऽपि R.vi.19.
यथा-भूतम् ind. according to what had happened, according to truth.
यथा-मुखीन a. looking straight, (with a gen.), (मृगः) यथामुखीनः सीतायाः पुप्लुवे बहु लोभयत् Bt.vi.48.
यथा-यथम् ind. 1. rightly, fitly, properly; 2. in regular order, severally, gradually, e.g. विप्रकीर्णा यथायथम्.
यथा-युक्तम्, -योगम् ind. suitably, according to circumstances.
यथा-युक्तम्, -योगम् ind. suitably, according to circumstances.
यथा-योग्य a. proper, right, fit.
यथा-रुचम्, -रुचि ind. according to taste.
यथा-रुचम्, -रुचि ind. according to taste.
यथा-रूपम् ind. 1. according to form or appearance; 2. properly, duly.
यथा-वत् ind. 1. properly, truly, correctly, लिपेर्यथावद् ग्रहणेन वाङ्मयं नदीमुखेनेव समुद्रमाविशत् R.iii.28; 2. according to law, वने वसेत्तु नियतो यथावद्विजितेंद्रियः M.vi.1.
यथा-वस्तु ind. accurately, exactly, truly.
यथा-विधि ind. according to precept or rule, duly, अथ स विषयव्यावृत्तात्मा यथाविधि सूनवे R.iii.70.
यथा-विभवम् ind. according to means, in proportion to wealth.
यथा-वृत्त (I) a. as happened, as acted.
यथा-वृत्त (II) n. 1. a previous event; 2. the details of an event.
यथा-शक्ति, -शक्त्या ind. as far as possible, to the utmost of one’s power.
यथा-शक्ति, -शक्त्या ind. as far as possible, to the utmost of one’s power.
यथा-शास्त्रम् ind. according to the precepts, as the law ordains, M.ii.70.
यथा-श्रुतम् ind. 1. as heard or reported; 2. according to the injunction of the Vedas.
यथा-संख्य n. a figure of speech in rhetoric, thus defined- and illustrated by Jayadeva- यथासंख्यं क्रमेनैव क्रमिकाणां समन्वयः । शत्रुं मित्रं विपत्तिं च जय रंजय भंजय Ch.L.v.107.
यथा-संख्यम्, -संख्येन ind. number for number, respectively, Yaj.i.21.
यथा-संख्यम्, -संख्येन ind. number for number, respectively, Yaj.i.21.
यथा-समयम् ind. 1. according to agreement or custom; 2. at the proper time.
यथा-संभव a. possible.
यथा-सुखम् ind. at ease, comfortably, अथ यथासुखमार्तवमुत्सवं समनुभूय विलासवतीसखः R.ix.48.
यथा-स्थितम् ind. 1. according to circumstances; 2. truly, properly.
यथा-स्वम् ind. 1. every one his own, अध्यासते चीरभृतो यथास्वम् R.viii.22; 2. each for himself or on his own account; 3. rightly, properly.
याथातथ्य n. 1. Reality, truth; 2. rectitude.
याथार्थ्य n. 1. Real nature, truth, स्वपतो जागरूकस्य याथार्थ्यं वेद कस्तव R.x.24, K.S.v.77; 2. suitableness; 3. attainment of an object.
